newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring and white bids up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring and white bids up.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat and soft white bids rose on Thursday in line with higher MGE wheat futures prices, dealers said.
Movement was scattered with some farm sales noted in parts of North Dakota, dealers said.
In Montana, farmers were busy with preparatory fieldwork for spring plantings and thus, farm sales were limited, a merchandiser said.

MGE spring wheat futures ended higher, supported by strong export sales data. The U.S. Department of Agriculture reported weekly export sales of 497,000 tonnes, which came in well above trade expectations for 100,000 to 300,000 tonnes.
MGE spring wheat closed up 5-1/2 to 7-1/2 cents a bushel, with May up 5-1/2 at $4.18-1/4 and July up 5-3/4 at $4.09.
